name: claudinho
description: Live scores, fixtures and standings for the competition you follow: the World Cup, the Premier League, LALIGA, the Champions League and eleven more. Not affiliated with FIFA or Anthropic.
long_description: Ask Claude about live football in the competition you follow — the World Cup, the Premier League, LALIGA, the Champions League and eleven more (list_competitions names them): live scores, today's fixtures, a team's next match, standings, the knockout bracket, and read-only prediction-market signals for the World Cup (informational only, not betting advice). Facts and emoji flags only; no logos, crests, or footage. An independent, open-source fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FIFA or Anthropic.

tools.name: get_today
tools.description: All fixtures for a date (default: today), with live scores overlaid; partial means a provider record was left out (an empty day with no bundled schedule merged is then none read, not none scheduled); optional market enrichment reports marketComplete.

tools.name: get_live
tools.description: Matches in play right now, with score and minute; an empty list with partial means none in play could be read, not that none is.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: A single match by id, with live score/minute when in play and optional marketComplete enrichment.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Live cumulative standings — every table, or one by its key (a group letter, or A1, A-B, LEAGUE).

tools.name: get_bracket
tools.description: Knockout bracket from the Round of 32 through the final, with live scores overlaid.

tools.name: get_next_fixture
tools.description: A team's next match, by name or code (a nation: Mexico, MEX; in a club competition, a club: Arsenal, ARS).

tools.name: get_market_signal
tools.description: Read-only prediction-market signals for a match, a team's next fixture, or a date. Reports completeness; informational only; no links.

tools.name: get_share_snippet
tools.description: A copy-pasteable snippet for a match, a team's next fixture, one standings table (group: a table key such as A, A1, A-B or LEAGUE), the knockout bracket, a date, or live. Reports marketComplete and partial (an empty live card, or an empty date card with no bundled schedule merged, is then none read); plain text; carries the disclaimer.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: The World Cup roster: resolve a nation name or code to its FIFA 3-letter code, flag, and group (fuzzy: 'Mexico', 'mex', 'DR Congo', 'Türkiye'). Offline; knows no clubs.

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: The supported competitions: each one's alias (what every other tool's competition argument takes), name, teams, kind, and capabilities (scores, next, standings, bracket, markets), plus the current selection. Offline.
